personality_one_liner: A friendly, vibrant, and highly interactive POS experience that feels tactile, fast, and approachable.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile spacing. Use 16px (lg) padding for screens and cards. 12px (md) gaps between elements. Large thumb-friendly touch targets with overshoot spring animations.

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Use heavy glassmorphism for the QRIS payment bottom sheet to make it feel elevated.
Use glass overlay on the login screen over the splash background.
dont's: Do not use glassmorphism on dense data cards or chart areas.
Do not blur form fields or input elements.

screens.name: Role Selection & Login
screens.purpose: Allow users to securely select their role and enter their PIN to access the app.

states.loading: Spinner over the abstract splash background.
states.error: Shake animation on PIN dots, red error text 'PIN Salah'.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background using 'splash_abstract' image with a top-down dark gradient scrim. Top center: 'JADI WANGI App' logo (Fredoka font, 'JADI WANGI' in lavender, 'App' badge in vivid azure). Middle: 3 chunky tactile cards for Role Selection (Owner, Pegawai, Pelanggan) wrapped in a glass container. Bottom: Large numeric PIN keypad with rounded 'md' buttons (no visible borders, just soft fill on press) filling the lower third.

screens.name: Owner Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Provide a high-level overview of daily KPIs, monthly revenue trends, and active laundry queues.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for KPI cards and chart area.
states.empty: Illustration of a clean laundry basket with 'Belum ada transaksi hari ini'.

screens.layout: Scrollable view with safe-area padding. Top: Sticky glass header with app logo and Owner avatar. Section 1 (KPIs): 2-column grid of tactile cards ('surfaceSecondary' background) showing Today's Transactions and Revenue. Section 2 (Chart): Full-width card with a Line/Bar chart for revenue trends (use vivid azure for the line, soft lavender gradient below). Section 3 (Queue): Horizontal scroll of pill-shaped counters (In-Progress, Ready, SLA-overdue). Overdue pills use 'error' colors to draw attention. Section 4 (Top Services): List rows with 'brandTertiary' tinted icon containers. FAB (Floating Action Button) in vivid azure for 'Buat Order' pinned above the bottom tabs.

screens.name: Create Order Flow
screens.purpose: Step-by-step process to create an order, calculate weight, and generate a QRIS payment.

states.loading: Centered spinner while fetching product list.
states.empty: No products available in this outlet.
states.error: Failed to generate QRIS or load products.

screens.layout: Form-like vertical scroll. Top: Outlet and Customer selector (tactile dropdowns). Middle: Grid of product/service cards (Wash, Dry, Iron, etc.). Large +/- pill-shaped stepper controls for entering weight (kg). Bottom: Fixed container (outside scroll) with a sticky 'Proceed to Payment' CTA in vivid azure. Upon CTA press, a glass bottom sheet slides up showing the QRIS code, countdown timer, and 'Confirm Payment' button.

screens.name: Employee Pipeline
screens.purpose: Track and update the real-time progress of active laundry orders.

states.empty: Illustration of empty hangers 'Tidak ada antrian saat ini'.

screens.layout: Top: Sticky horizontal scroll of pipeline stages (Cuci -> Pengering -> Setrika -> Lipat -> Selesai) acting as filter tabs. Active tab highlighted in vivid azure pill. Below: Vertical list of order cards. Each card contains Customer Name, SLA Timer (color shifts from success to warning to error based on time), and a chunky primary CTA button to move the order to the 'Next Stage'.

screens.name: Customer Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Allow customers to view their ranking at the outlet and place new orders.
screens.layout: Top half: Playful visual podium (Top 3 customers) using overlapping avatars and gold/silver/bronze badges on a soft lavender gradient background. Bottom half: List of remaining rankings. Floating sticky CTA 'Order Sekarang' at the bottom to jump into the QRIS payment flow.

login_background.alt: Abstract blue and purple water splash

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '4 Tactile / Playful' personality rigorously. Use generous spacing (md/lg), chunky rounded radii (sm: 12, md: 16, lg: 24, pill: 999), and playful bounce/overshoot animations for interactions.

Implement the 'JADI WANGI App' logo text exactly as requested: 'JADI WANGI' in lavender (`brand`) using the bubble-like Fredoka font, and the 'App' badge styled as a vivid azure (`brandPrimary`) pill next to it.

For the Owner Dashboard, ensure the Revenue Trend chart looks modern. Use the `brandPrimary` (vivid azure) for the chart line and a subtle vertical gradient (surfaceSecondary to transparent) for the fill.
Use Phosphor icons. Active tab icons should be Filled, while inactive ones should be Outline/Regular.
Implement a strict safe-area margin at the bottom for screens with scrollable content and sticky CTAs. The 'Proceed to Payment' button must float above the scroll view.
Ensure the QRIS payment view uses a `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` with an `expo-glass-effect` or `expo-blur` background to create a premium, elevated feel.
Avoid generic blue/indigo default palettes. The entire app must strictly revolve around the provided Lavender (`#A78BFA`) and Vivid Azure (`#0096FF`) color tokens.
Integrate haptic feedback on all primary actions (tab changes, order pipeline stage advances, weight +/- adjustments) using `expo-haptics`.
